summary.zh: 查清一次会话为何变慢、返工或结果不佳
summary.en: Trace why a session ran slow, cost too much or went off track.

description.zh: 结合你对问题的描述，读取磁盘上的会话记录逐步定位，按技能调用、计划执行、重复劳动、卡顿和耗时成本等维度分析，最后给出带出处引用的报告。适合复盘一次返工、超时或花销异常的运行，也可据此整理问题反馈。
description.en: Starts from what went wrong, finds the transcripts on disk and reviews them by skill timeline, plan adherence, repeated work, stumbles and cost. Returns a report where each finding cites file and line. Good for post-mortems and bug reports.
